title: Settings
disconnect_description: Disconnect from the API and enter a different token. Use this if the server restarted with a new token.
export_description: Download all your collections and items as a JSON backup file.
import_description: Restore from a backup file. Existing collections and items are kept; only new ones are added.
import_success: Imported {{collectionsImported}} collections and {{itemsImported}} items ({{collectionsSkipped}} collections and {{itemsSkipped}} items already present were skipped).
import_error: Import failed. Make sure you chose a valid MyCollections backup file.
error_reporting_description: Error reports help diagnose crashes. They contain no collection data and are only logged locally in your browser — nothing ever leaves this device.
